svg.title: Main Street Drive Wild Rag, round 2. Neo-Western lane, Visit Salt Lake
svg.text: One color on silk. The longhorn drive down Main Street, drawn as one picture.
Tied, the skyline sits in the fold and the herd runs down the tails.
The same steer, engraved on the brass bolo slide sold with it.

text.tspan: The whole drive in one line: Wasatch, towers,
the rails on Main, three ranks of longhorns
and the riders holding the edge. The mountains
stay behind the towers because that is the view.
